---
title: Top-level title
subtitle: Top-level subtitle
format:
  html:
    title: Format title
    subtitle: Format subtitle
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '<h1 class="title">Format title</h1>'
          - '<p class="subtitle lead">Format subtitle</p>'
        - []
---

A key set both at the top level and under `format: html:` in the same document takes the format-level value in the output. The document is not executed (markdown engine), so this checks the merge order of document metadata on its own: the executed-front-matter substitution done before calling pandoc must not bring the top-level value back.
